summary.text: Craig Swartz is an independent candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 87 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Realtor, Swartz said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is political director of the Ohio Public Banking Coalition and is campaigning for a state public bank modeled on the Bank of North Dakota.

paragraphs.text: Craig Swartz was born in Middleburg Heights, Ohio, graduated from Midpark High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Ohio State University in 1980.

He also studied at Schiller International University, and his career experience includes work as an international legal assistant and advisor, restaurant owner, writer, factory worker, insurance agent and Realtor.
Swartz ran in the 2024 general election for District 87.
In his survey he said he had run for office several times before as a Democrat and chose to run as an independent this time.
He listed a Bank of Ohio to fund affordable housing and childcare as his main proposal, and also called for full funding of public education and dismantling JobsOhio.
